Isso só acontece quando você toca em enviar — nada é enviado automaticamente.

video_shader_preset_mode_c_hq: Alta qualidade para animes SD antigos (480p) com borrões de compressão. Exige uma GPU potente.

Para ir além com shaders como o Anime4K, abra o Aprimoramento de imagem com um vídeo em reprodução e escolha um nível ali.

video_shader_first_use_body: 想让动画画面更清晰，可以进入“画质增强”并点击“下载 Anime4K 推荐着色器”。下载后在已安装列表里勾选即可启用。

floating_lyric_unavailable_hint: Não foi possível mostrar a janela de legenda flutuante.
video_shader_tier_off_hint: Sem aprimoramento. Reproduz o vídeo original como está.
video_shader_tier_low_hint: Nitidez integrada do mpv (ewa_lanczossharp). Funciona em qualquer vídeo (animação e ação ao vivo). Sem download, menor carga na GPU. Escolha esta opção em placas integradas ou antigas (NVIDIA GTX 1050, AMD RX 560, iGPU Intel).
video_shader_tier_medium_hint: Anime4K Fast. Melhor para animação, mas também funciona em filmes/séries de ação ao vivo (ganho menor). Roda em GPUs intermediárias (NVIDIA GTX 1660 / RTX 3050, AMD RX 6600).
video_shader_tier_high_hint: Anime4K HQ. Mais nítido; melhor para animação, também utilizável em ação ao vivo (ganho menor). Exige uma GPU intermediária-alta (NVIDIA RTX 4060 / RTX 3070, AMD RX 6700 XT / RX 7700 XT).
video_shader_tier_ultra_hint: Anime4K Mode A (UL, rede ultragrande). A reconstrução Anime4K mais potente; também utilizável em ação ao vivo (ganho menor). Exige uma GPU de topo (NVIDIA RTX 4080 / RTX 5090, AMD RX 7900 XTX). Escolha um nível mais baixo se sua GPU for mais fraca.
video_shader_tier_custom_hint: Seleção personalizada de shaders. Escolha um nível acima para voltar a uma predefinição.
video_shader_mobile_perf_hint: Em celulares, os shaders só são aplicados no caminho de renderização padrão da GPU, e a eficácia varia conforme a GPU do aparelho; níveis mais altos podem perder quadros ou esquentar. Comece com Baixo/Médio e confira o resultado no seu dispositivo.

game_hook_reason_injection_failed: Injection into the game was blocked; add Hibiki and the game to antivirus exclusions.
game_hook_reason_guarded_hook_failed: A profile-guarded hook could not be installed in time; retrying automatically.
game_hook_reason_resume_failed: The launched game could not be resumed and was stopped; launch it again.
game_hook_reason_steam_timeout: Steam accepted the launch request but the game process never appeared.
game_hook_reason_shared_memory_unavailab: The capture channel could not be opened; restart Hibiki.
game_hook_reason_handshake_timeout: The game was hooked but produced no text or audio in time; this engine may not be supported yet.
video_setting_auto_scrape_hint: Silently fetch cover, synopsis, rating and tags from Bangumi for videos in your library
video_scrape_info_empty: No series info yet. It is fetched automatically in the background; you can also match it manually.
games_no_match: No games match the current filters
game_detail_missing: This game is no longer in the library
game_summary_none: No description yet. Fetch metadata to fill it in.
stat_goal_scope_hint: Counts all characters combined: reading + video subtitles + game text.
data_root_unavailable_message: Your configured data location $path is temporarily unreachable (the drive may be asleep, busy, or disconnected). Your data is safe and untouched there — nothing is lost. Tap Retry once the drive is ready to load your data, or start with the default location for now (your existing data will NOT be modified).
browser_extension_version_mismatch: The extension loaded in your browser is outdated. Prepare the extension again if needed, then reload it from your browser's extensions page (chrome://extensions).
book_scrape_search_failed: Search failed. Tap Search to retry.
anime_download_search_error_proxy_hint: If the site cannot be reached directly, configure a network proxy in download settings.
audio_source_edit_target_gone: That audio source no longer exists — edit discarded
game_capture_degraded_loopback: The game is running, but engine injection failed; falling back to system audio, which can mix in BGM and effects.
game_capture_window_missing: The game process started but its window never appeared, so the game may not have launched. Try starting it again.
yomitan_port_kill_failed: Could not end $process. Please end it manually, then retry.
yomitan_port_kill_confirm_message: The port is currently used by: $process
yomitan_port_kill_self_instance: This process is another running instance of this app.
yomitan_port_kill_protected: $process is a critical system process — Hibiki will not end it. Change the port instead.
gal_hook_text_font_size_hint: Drag the overlay's corner to resize the window; the caption size is set here.
game_hook_fallback_engine_pcm_unavailabl: The engine voice hook is installed, but the game has not played any voice yet. System mix is used for now and will switch back automatically once the first voice arrives.
game_hook_fallback_all_audio_sources_fai: Neither the engine voice hook nor the system loopback could be started; no audio can be captured.
game_hook_fallback_window_not_found: Audio capture is running, but the game window has not appeared yet, so screenshots are unavailable. It will bind automatically once the window shows up.
game_hook_fallback_engine_attach_failed: Attaching the engine voice hook to the running game failed; system mix is used instead.
game_hook_fallback_launch_injection_fail: The game is running, but early engine injection failed; system mix is used instead.
game_tracks_pcm_only_hint: Per-track selection only affects capture while engine PCM is the active audio backend. The list below is read-only under the current backend.
game_track_no_clips: No clips in the recent window
game_line_track_tooltip: Pick the voice track for this line
game_line_track_failed: That track has no audio around this line
game_line_track_applied: Voice track applied to this line
game_edit_launch_args_hint: Passed to the game on launch, e.g. -windowed
galgame_helper_verification_failed: Engine component blocked: its checksum could not be verified (the .sha256 file from GitHub is unreachable, missing, or does not match). Hibiki refuses to install unverified injector code.
download_save_root_hint: New downloads are saved here. Existing tasks keep their original folder.
download_save_root_not_absolute: Please pick an absolute folder path.
download_save_root_create_failed: Cannot create that folder. Check the drive and permissions.
download_save_root_fallback_warning: The configured download folder is unavailable, so the default folder is being used.
galgame_upscaling_hint: Uses Magpie to upscale the galgame window while a hook session is running. Auto downloads Magpie on first use.
galgame_upscaling_download_body: Game window upscaling needs Magpie (about 10 MB, GPL-3.0, built by us from source). Download it now?
galgame_upscaling_status_manual: Window upscaling is ready, but did not start on its own
galgame_upscaling_hint_first_run: Magpie still had to set itself up this time. Press Win+Shift+A to upscale now — next time you start the game it will happen automatically.
galgame_upscaling_hint_external: A copy of Magpie was already running, so Hibiki left it alone. Press Win+Shift+A to upscale the game window.
galgame_upscaling_hint_manual: Press Win+Shift+A to upscale the game window.
galgame_upscaling_hint_not_installed: Magpie is not installed. Set window upscaling to Auto to download it.
